q: What is an ablation in harness engineering?
options: Removing or changing one harness part and rerunning the eval to measure its effect
explain: One change at a time, judged by the eval, shows which parts earn their place.

q: Why re-run ablations when you upgrade the model?
options: Tricks that helped the old model can hurt the new one
explain: Harness choices are tuned to a model; re-check them on every upgrade.

q: Why run each eval task several times before comparing harness variants?
options: Agent runs are nondeterministic, so single runs can hide or invent differences
explain: Measure the noise, then compare with intervals.
